description: A consolidated set of artisan's tools — hammers, files, chisels, awls, needles, and shaping implements covering smithing, carpentry, masonry, leatherworking, weaving, woodcarving, glassblowing, and pottery. The tools of a maker who builds and mends.
name: Crafting Kit
notes: +2 Crafting while carried. Only the best carried bonus to a skill counts.
Mend…: 30 minutes and a Crafting check (DC 12) bring worn armour, a shield or a blunt or ranged weapon back up to Worn; a failed check mends half as much. Only a smith makes it new.
